description: GOST (GO Simple Tunnel): a multi-protocol forward proxy and tunnel (HTTP, SOCKS5, relay, port forwarding over TCP, TLS, QUIC or WebSocket). Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

cloudflared, the Cloudflare Tunnel client: publishes in-cluster services through Cloudflare without opening inbound ports, using a tunnel token. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

frp server (frps): a fast reverse proxy that exposes services behind NAT or a firewall through frpc clients, with its web dashboard. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

Vouch Proxy: SSO for nginx auth_request. Logs users in through OIDC or OAuth (Google, GitHub, Okta, Keycloak, any OIDC issuer) and answers /validate for every request, so apps without a login sit behind SSO.
